title: Carrier
description: A single waste carrier. organisationName, meansOfTransport and contactDetails are required, and exactly one of registrationNumber or reasonForNoRegistrationNumber must be provided. vehicleRegistration is required for Road and otherMeansOfTransport for Other; each is forbidden otherwise. address is optional.

reasonForNoRegistrationNumber.description: Not allowed when registrationNumber is provided.

registrationNumber.description: Not allowed when reasonForNoRegistrationNumber is provided.

vehicleRegistration.description: Not allowed unless meansOfTransport is Road.

otherMeansOfTransport.description: Not allowed unless meansOfTransport is Other.

registrationNumber.description: Waste carrier registration number, in a valid UK home-nation format (England and NRW CBDU/CBDL, SEPA WCR/SCO/SEA/SNO/SWE and PCT, NI ROC UT/LT). Mutually exclusive with reasonForNoRegistrationNumber — exactly one of the two is required.

reasonForNoRegistrationNumber.description: Why the carrier has no registration number. Mutually exclusive with registrationNumber — exactly one of the two is required.

meansOfTransport.description: How the carrier will transport the waste.

vehicleRegistration.description: Registration of the vehicle carrying the waste. Required when meansOfTransport is Road; forbidden otherwise.

otherMeansOfTransport.description: Description of the means of transport. Required when meansOfTransport is Other; forbidden otherwise.
